name: Zara the Emerald Agent
source:
Zara is a mutant with the power to see the future, a capability that could be used for the common good, but she has chosen to exploit it solely for personal gain. With her gift, Zara has accumulated wealth and power, manipulating events and people in her favor to build a personal empire. Her precognitive ability makes her a formidable opponent, capable of anticipating every move and exploiting every opportunity to increase her capital, with no interest in justice or the well-being of others.

[In game description]
